searchText: <#688075293562503241> was correct. Thanks Micah! Is the byte-representation of a certain object unique with SSZ, or are there multiple encodings possible that map to the same object? SSZ should be injective — so I’d say yes, it is unique. I’ll try to find a link for that <https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/ssz/simple-serialize.md#deserialization>
